detail.archivedDescription: The history and the evidence remain available for consultation.
detail.deletedDescription: Related evidence, analyses and validations were removed.

detail.workflowAnalysisDescription: Ask Gemini for findings, contradictions and limitations.

research.title: Search the web for sources
research.description: The query is built from this investigation's topic, keywords and objective. Results come straight from the Exa API.

research.repeatHint: To repeat deliberately, check “Repeat even if an identical recent one exists” and run again.
research.emptyTitle: No search run in this session
research.emptyDescription: Run a query to see real sources returned by Exa. Results are not stored until you select and add them as evidence.
research.noResultsDescription: Exa found no sources for this query. Try broader terms, remove constraints or rephrase the investigation objective.
research.addedDescription: The sources were persisted with URL, snippet, available content and prioritisation index.

research.noSnippet: No snippet returned by the provider.
research.failureTimeout: The provider took too long to respond
research.addedToastNext: You can now request a structured analysis.
research.searchEmptyDetail: Exa returned no sources for this query.

evidence.title: Collected sources
evidence.description: Every evidence item preserves the original URL, the content actually retrieved and the prioritisation index computed at collection time.
evidence.emptyDescription: Add a source manually by providing a title and a URL, or run an external search and select the results that support the objective.
evidence.searchPlaceholder: Search by title, domain or snippet
evidence.noMatchDescription: Adjust the search or the status to see other sources in this investigation.
evidence.deleteDescription: The source and its priority analysis will be removed from this investigation.
evidence.deleteNote: Analyses already generated that cite this evidence keep the reference in the historical record, but the source will no longer be available for consultation. The deletion event is recorded in the history.
evidence.noPriorityData: No prioritisation data for this source.
evidence.indexNote: This index orders the researcher's attention. It is not a probability of truth nor a judgement about the scientific quality of the source.
evidence.manualDescription: Register a source you already know. No external search is performed.
evidence.sourceTitleHint: How this source will be identified in the list.
evidence.sourceUrlHint: Full address of the source. Only http or https.

evidence.noteDescription: Record why this source is relevant, caveats, or what still needs verification.

evidence.alreadyTitle: This source is already in this investigation
evidence.deletedDetail: The event was recorded in the investigation history.

analysis.description: The analysis is produced by Google Gemini from the evidence stored in this investigation, and nothing else. References to sources that do not exist invalidate the result.
analysis.disabledDescription: External calls are off or the Gemini key is not configured in the backend.
analysis.quotaDescription: The counter resets {when}. Previous analyses remain accessible.
analysis.noEvidenceDescription: Add sources to the investigation before requesting an analysis. The AI only receives evidence that actually exists.
analysis.emptyDescription: The analysis organises the evidence into an executive summary, findings with references, contradictions and limitations. It does not decide whether a source is true — that remains with you.
analysis.confirmDescription: A call to the provider will be made and will consume one analysis from your daily quota.
analysis.confirmSentIntro: {count} evidence item(s) from this investigation will be sent to Google Gemini, including title, URL, domain, date and the retrieved content of each source, along with the investigation objective.
analysis.confirmRuleCited: Every finding must cite real evidence from the submitted set.
analysis.confirmRuleInvalid: References that do not exist invalidate the whole analysis.
analysis.confirmRuleContradictions: Contradictions between sources are reported, not arbitrarily resolved.
analysis.confirmRuleData: Source content is treated as data, never as instructions.
analysis.confirmNote: Human approval of an evidence item is not a certificate of scientific or legal truth.
analysis.insufficientTitle: The AI considered the evidence set insufficient
analysis.insufficientDescription: The model explicitly stated that the available sources do not support strong conclusions. Read the limitations and gaps below before using this result.
analysis.summaryDescription: Synthesis produced from the submitted evidence
analysis.findingsDescription: Each item cites the evidence that supports it
analysis.findingsEmpty: No finding was presented — the model found insufficient support.
analysis.supportedDescription: Claims with direct backing in the submitted material
analysis.supportedEmpty: No claim was marked as directly supported.
analysis.contradictionsDescription: Divergences between sources that you need to resolve
analysis.contradictionsEmpty: No contradiction was identified among the submitted evidence.
analysis.limitationsEmpty: No limitation declared by the model.
analysis.objectiveDescription: How the set answers the investigation question
analysis.objectiveEmpty: The model did not assess alignment with the objective.
analysis.referencesDescription: Only real evidence from this investigation can appear here
analysis.disclaimer: This synthesis was generated by a language model and validated only for schema and for the existence of the references. It does not replace factual verification by a researcher.
analysis.generatingDescription: References are checked against the real evidence before the result is displayed.
analysis.failureTimeout: Gemini took too long to respond

validationPage.emptyDescriptionOther: Switch tabs to see evidence in another state, or add new sources to the investigation.

landing.heroBody: SignalMesh organises external sources into traceable evidence, confronts what they say with your investigation's objective, and keeps every conclusion tied to the source that supports it. The analysis is done by AI; the final decision is always human.
landing.heroTrust: Sign-in required · data isolated per user · external API usage capped
landing.pipelineNote: every step is recorded in the history
landing.stepSearchBody: Query to Exa built from the topic and the objective
landing.stepCollectBody: Selected sources become evidence with URL and snippet
landing.stepValidateBody: Human decision with a recorded justification
landing.stepExportBody: JSON and CSV with relations preserved
landing.capabilitiesTitle: Traceability as a requirement, not an optional feature
landing.capabilitiesBody: SignalMesh is not a chat. It is a workspace where the origin of every statement stays visible — including when the answer is “the sources do not support this conclusion”.
landing.featureEvidenceBody: Every finding cites the IDs of the evidence that support it. References that do not exist in the submitted set invalidate the whole analysis.
landing.featureAnalysisBody: Executive summary, findings, contradictions, limitations, gaps and objective alignment — in a validated schema, not free text.
landing.featureValidationBody: Approving, rejecting or requesting review requires a justification. Every change of decision creates a new event; nothing is overwritten.
landing.featurePriorityBody: A prioritisation index with explicit weights and a justification per component. It is ordering, not a probability of truth.
landing.featureIsolationBody: Ownership is verified on the server for every operation. Changing the ID in the URL does not open another person's data.
landing.featureQuotaBody: Daily per-user and global limits, a lock against concurrent runs and a master switch for external calls.
landing.principleBody: A language model can summarise, compare and point out tensions between sources. It cannot declare that something is true. SignalMesh treats the model output as a structured draft that a researcher must review, evidence by evidence.
landing.refusesTitle: What the system refuses to do
landing.refuseUrls: Invent URLs, titles or sources that are not in the investigation.
landing.refuseContradiction: Pick a version as true when the sources contradict each other.
landing.refuseQuota: Keep calling a paid provider after a quota error.
landing.refuseFakeNumbers: Show sample numbers as if they were real data.
landing.ctaTitle: Start an investigation with a defined objective
landing.ctaBody: SignalMesh requires an explicit objective because that is what guides the research, the analysis and the alignment assessment of every source.
landing.footerNote: Selected research content may be sent to external providers (Exa for search and Google Gemini for analysis) strictly to process your requests. No credential is exposed to the browser.

newInvestigation.title: Define what you want to find out
newInvestigation.description: The topic bounds the subject; the objective defines the concrete question the research must answer. Both are used to build the external query and to assess the alignment of every source.
newInvestigation.sectionIdentityHint: A short, recognisable title. You can edit it later.
newInvestigation.fieldTitleHint: E.g. Detecting financial fraud with AI in Brazil
newInvestigation.fieldTopicHint: The subject in one sentence. It is used as the basis of the search query.
newInvestigation.fieldTopicPlaceholder: E.g. use of artificial intelligence to detect financial fraud in Brazil
newInvestigation.fieldDescriptionHint: Context, scope and what is out of scope.
newInvestigation.fieldDescriptionPlaceholder: Investigation context, boundaries and source inclusion criteria.
newInvestigation.sectionObjectiveHint: The question the investigation must answer. Be specific — this text anchors the analysis and the source alignment score.
newInvestigation.fieldObjectiveHint: E.g. identify real applications, institutions involved, technologies used and published results.
newInvestigation.fieldObjectivePlaceholder: Describe what needs to be discovered, with the level of detail that would let someone judge whether the investigation succeeded.
newInvestigation.keywordsHint: Add one term at a time and press Enter. Pasting a semicolon-separated list also works.
newInvestigation.sectionStatusHint: Draft keeps the investigation out of the active flow until you review the objective.
newInvestigation.tipNamesAnswer: Names what counts as an answer (institutions, technologies, results).
newInvestigation.tipBoundsScope: Bounds time and geography when that matters.
newInvestigation.tipAvoidBinary: Avoids binary questions like “does AI work?”.
newInvestigation.privacyBody: The topic, the objective and the selected evidence may be sent to the external providers configured to process the research and the analysis. Do not include sensitive personal data.
newInvestigation.createdDetail: The next step is to run the external research.
newInvestigation.createError: Could not create the investigation. Try again.
newInvestigation.summaryError: Could not create the investigation: {count} field(s) need attention.

login.headline: Every conclusion tied to the source that supports it.
login.body: Organise research, collect evidence, request structured analyses and record the human decision — with a complete history of every step.
login.pointSession: Persistent session, revocable on the server
login.pointIsolation: Your data never appears to another account
login.disclaimer: By signing in you acknowledge that selected research content may be sent to the configured external providers for processing.
login.title: Sign in to SignalMesh

login.emailHint: Used only to identify your account in this environment.
login.nameHint: If empty, we derive it from the email.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Status of the external providers, consumption limits and your account data in this environment.
settings.providersDescription: Keys are read only by the backend
settings.providerKeysNote: To configure the keys, set EXA_API_KEY and GEMINI_API_KEY in the backend environment and restart the server. No credential is sent to the browser or stored in the database.
settings.limitsDescription: Cost protection applied on the server
settings.limitsNote: The counter resets at UTC midnight ({date}). Limits are defined in the server configuration and enforced in the backend; this page only reports the effective value and the consumption.
settings.usageDescription: Every attempt is recorded — including blocks by limit.
settings.usageEmptyDescription: Searches on Exa and analyses on Gemini appear here with provider, operation, result and date.
settings.privacyBody1: When you run a search, the query derived from the topic and the objective is sent to Exa. When you request an analysis, the investigation objective and the content of the stored evidence are sent to Google Gemini. That data is processed by the respective providers under their own policies.
settings.privacyBody2: No credential, session token or other user's data is included in those calls. SignalMesh does not use managed AI or the hosting platform's paid proxy for research or analysis.
settings.privacyRuleUntrusted: Source content is treated as untrusted data, never as an instruction.
settings.privacyRuleReferences: References that do not exist invalidate the whole analysis.
settings.privacyRuleLogs: Logs do not record credentials or request bodies.
settings.privacyRuleExports: Exports include only your account's data.
